headline: Fresh Turnovers Mark the Contested Sectors
war_summary: Nevish Line’s daily base-event count has eased from 74 to 70, yet five events arrived in the latest two hours; its ownership tally now reads seven Warden bases and one Colonial, against five and three in the last edition. Marban Hollow remains at 17 events for the day, with four in the latest two hours. Weathered Expanse has slipped from 51 daily events to 48, though four were logged in the latest two hours; its balance is now seven Warden bases and two neutral, with no Colonial bases. Linn Mercy’s daily count is down from 16 to 13, but activity has returned, including one recent event. Farranac Coast recorded two events in two hours, leaving one base neutral, while Stonecradle also logged two recent events. Kuura Strand has quieted, with no events in the latest two hours. War 140 remains undecided; the victory requirement is 34 towns.
